title: Libre Manga Translator
summary: Browser-based manga translation extension combining on-device bubble detection/OCR/inpainting/typesetting with local WebLLM, opt-in remote vision, or self-hosted OpenAI-compatible text translation.
documentation_observations: README explicitly separates local, self-hosted API and Gemini cloud modes: the cloud mode sends artwork, while API mode sends extracted text.
README documents manual bubble refinement, in-page editor, typesetting and PNG/JPEG export, plus current known OCR limitations.
limitations: Official documentation reviewed, but not installed or benchmarked by NaughtyBoddy. Low-refusal behavior, actual quality, privacy, performance and current release availability are not proven.
